state.from: A concrete input is visible but its consequence is unknown.
state.to: The input has been routed to the one consequence named by the narration.
state.newUnderstanding: The viewer can see the causal relationship, not just read its label.

primaryMotion.semanticReason: The moving input establishes which output it causes.

readableHold.reason: The causal result must remain readable before the handoff.

handoff.midpointAssertion: The consequence remains readable while its frame becomes the next beat's evidence frame.

beats.deletionTest: Removing the route would hide which input produced the result.
rejectionConditions: The beat is implemented only as opacity plus upward translation.
Decorative lines have no start or end anchor.
The handoff passes through an empty frame.

assertions: The input is visible and the consequence is not yet claimed.
The input is visibly connected to exactly one consequence.
The consequence remains the readable subject of the frame.

state.from: The confirmed consequence has just arrived from B01.
state.to: The same evidence remains stable for inspection.
state.newUnderstanding: The viewer has enough time to read and verify the evidence.

beats.stillReason: This beat is for evidence reading; extra movement would compete with comprehension.

readableHold.reason: The evidence must remain fully legible for the entire beat.

beats.deletionTest: Shortening the hold would remove the viewer's opportunity to verify the evidence.
rejectionConditions: The evidence card floats or breathes continuously.
A decorative transition covers the evidence.
The shot adds unrelated icons or particles.

assertions: The evidence inherited from B01 is already visible.
All evidence text is stable, legible, and unobstructed.
